changeSet.author: nexus-sa731
changeSet.comment: CREATE OR REPLACE nexus.gc_quarantine_orphans: same signature and return shape as catalog-024-1. Takes the EXCLUSIVE half of the RDR-191 sweep gate (same advisory-lock key CatalogRepository#acquireSweepGateShared/acquireSweepGateExclusive use, "sweepgate:<tenant>/<collection>") once at function start, closing the write-skew window between the manifest-reference guard and the chunk move. Also collapses the guard into the move statements' own WHERE (inline NOT EXISTS) instead of a precomputed v_chashes array, deleting the now-redundant standalone guard SELECT. ROUND 2 (stacked review): the acquisition is bounded by the same lock_timeout/statement_timeout pair acquireSweepGateExclusive uses, with a lock_not_available timeout re-raised as an explicit, retryable error naming the gate -- an unbounded wait here would hang this function's synchronous HTTP caller indefinitely.
